title: Beyond Bitwidth: Deployment-Constrained Mixed-Precision Quantization for Multilingual LLM Inference on NVIDIA Blackwell
abstract: arXiv:2611.21974v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Low-bit LLM quantization is useful only if a model preserves service-relevant accuracy, executes through supported GPU kernels, and meets measured memory and latency limits. We study Qwen3-8B on NVIDIA B200 with vLLM, including INT2/INT3, GPTQ, NVFP4, and mixed-precision configurations. We verify native packed execution and precision on all 144 fused linear modules and evaluate Korean, English, numerical, and reasoning quality under preregistered gates. Packed INT2 and INT3 execute, but all seven tested INT2 grids degenerate on generation. Isolated module-restoration effects are strongly non-additive; Korean and reasoning sensitivity rankings disagree, and a promising INT4/INT8 development candidate fails independent final evaluation. A configuration with 16-bit activations, 98 NVFP4 weight-only modules, 46 INT8 modules, and an INT8 output head passes all gates on the untouched FINAL-81 set (5,168 items): 5.917 GiB of weight-loading me

translated_title: 超越位宽：面向NVIDIA Blackwell多语言大模型推理的部署约束混合精度量化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.21974v1 公告类型： cross 摘要：低比特大模型量化只有在模型保持与服务相关的精度、能够通过受支持的GPU内核执行、并满足实测的内存和延迟限制时才有实用价值。我们在NVIDIA B200上使用vLLM研究Qwen3-8B，涵盖INT2/INT3、GPTQ、NVFP4以及混合精度配置。我们在全部144个融合线性模块上验证了原生打包执行与精度，并在预注册的门槛条件下评估韩语、英语、数值和推理质量。打包的INT2和INT3虽然可以执行，但所有七种测试的INT2网格在生成任务上均出现退化。孤立的模块恢复效应表现出强烈的非加性；韩语与推理任务的敏感性排名互不一致，且一个看似有前景的INT4/INT8开发候选方案在独立的最终评估中失败。一个包含16位激活、98个NVFP4仅权重量化模块、46个INT8模块和INT8输出头的配置，在未做任何改动的FINAL-81测试集（5,168个条目）上通过了全部门槛，权重加载内存为5.917 GiB……
tldr: 该论文在NVIDIA B200上对Qwen3-8B进行了部署约束驱动的低比特与混合精度量化实测评估，发现INT2/INT3全面退化且模块恢复效应具有强非加性，最终提出一个NVFP4与INT8混合的配置，在通过全部预注册多语言与推理精度门槛的同时将权重内存压缩至5.917 GiB。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a deployment-constrained mixed-precision quantization study of Qwen3-8B on NVIDIA B200, showing that INT2/INT3 uniformly degenerates and module-restoration effects are strongly non-additive, and delivers an NVFP4+INT8 mixed configuration that passes all preregistered multilingual and reasoning accuracy gates while compressing weight memory to 5.917 GiB.
